descriptor: Now-playing card for an original song by Maren Vale

voice.summary: Speaks like liner notes: gentle, image-led and a little hushed. Lyrics are the star, so interface text stays small and warm.
dos: Quote a lyric line when you can
Keep controls to a verb or a symbol
Credit artist and album every time
donts: No spoilers of the whole lyric in a tagline

boilerplate: Paper Lanterns is an original song by Maren Vale from the album Low Tide Letters, presented as a now-playing card with lyrics that light up word by word.

microcopy.error: Playback paused, tap play to continue
microcopy.empty: Press play to start the lyrics

logo.note: A play triangle fits a now-playing card.
